quirks.description: PureSpectrum screeners may request a full or partial UK postcode but reject the full postcode.
quirks.guidance: PureSpectrum's postcode field must receive only the UK outward/partial postcode, even when the page says full or partial. Example: SW1A 1AA becomes SW1A. Never retry the full postcode on this field.

quirks.description: Qmee can retain stale survey/concurrency state in the dashboard tab after a completed survey.
quirks.guidance: After any completed, screened-out, failed, or abandoned survey, open a completely fresh Qmee dashboard tab and close the prior survey/dashboard tabs before choosing the next offer. If Qmee reports that a survey is already active, continue with the new survey and report the previous one as broken/stuck after an abandonment, not finished.

quirks.description: Prime Opinion can retain a stale completion/streak overlay and detached Gotcha control after redirect.
quirks.guidance: After a verified completion, immediately recreate the Prime Opinion surveys dashboard. Do not keep clicking a stale Gotcha control. Select a ranked survey card, then use the live Start Survey and Participate controls exposed by the refreshed page.
